module_name_en: Core Words III and Graded Reading
block_note: Level 37 said a loanword's gender is simply assigned and has to be learned. Nine technology words in a row is the place to say something more useful than that, so levels 41 to 43 refine it: there is a default and there is a learnable set of exceptions, and some recent borrowings have not settled at all. Three of this batch — ऑनलाइन, सँभालना and जताना — have already appeared in earlier texts, which is the preview a vocabulary item is allowed.

learn.title_en: ऐपों में — an English word taking a Hindi oblique
learn.explanation_en: ऐप is masculine, and flag it, because a loanword's gender is never visible in its shape. What is worth watching is how completely it behaves as a Hindi noun: ऐप डाउनलोड करना, ऐप में, and before a postposition the oblique plural ऐपों में. You will also hear ऐप्स में with the English plural kept, and both are current — exactly the same split as फ़ोल्डरों and फ़ोल्डर्स in the Module 12 office handover. The Hindi ending appears once the word has been absorbed rather than quoted.

examples.hindi: ये ऐप बहुत काम का है।
examples.read_as: ye aip bahut kaam kaa hai.
examples.note: का, masculine, agreeing with ऐप.
करना does the grammatical work, as always with borrowed verbs.

examples.hindi: इन ऐपों में सब कुछ मिल जाता है।
examples.read_as: in aipoṁ meṁ sab kuchh mil jaataa hai.
examples.english: You find everything in these apps.
examples.note: The Hindi oblique plural, before में.

common_error.wrong: ये ऐप बहुत काम की है
common_error.right: ये ऐप बहुत काम का है
common_error.why_en: ऐप is masculine. There is nothing in the word to tell you, which is why it is flagged.

practice.prompt_en: Which is the Hindi oblique plural of ऐप?
practice.explanation_en: ऐपों. ऐप्स is the English plural, also heard, but it is not the oblique.

game.question_en: Which word means software in general?
game.explanation_en: सॉफ़्टवेयर, also masculine. उपकरण is a device or instrument, and is the Sanskrit-side word.

tts_strings: इन ऐपों में सब कुछ मिल जाता है।

learn.title_en: नेटवर्क नहीं आ रहा — the signal does the failing
learn.explanation_en: नेटवर्क is masculine, and flag it. In everyday use it means the mobile signal rather than a network in the abstract: नेटवर्क नहीं आ रहा, there's no signal. Notice the shape of that sentence — the network is the subject and it is failing to come, exactly as आवाज़ नहीं आ रही did on the bad phone line in Module 12. Hindi keeps putting the thing in the subject slot where English puts the person, and technology talk is full of it.

examples.note: रहा, masculine, and the auxiliary dropped.
कमज़ोर, invariable.

examples.hindi: बारिश में नेटवर्क चला जाता है।
examples.read_as: baarish meṁ neṭvark chalaa jaataa hai.
examples.english: The signal goes in the rain.
examples.note: चला जाना, the irregular compound from Module 11 where both words agree.

common_error.why_en: The signal is not coming to you in particular. No dative is needed.

practice.prompt_en: नेटवर्क नहीं आ रहा means what?
options: The call did not go through
practice.explanation_en: In everyday Hindi नेटवर्क is the signal on your phone.

game.question_en: Which word would a technician use for a connection?
game.explanation_en: कनेक्शन is a connection, and it is masculine. लाइन, from the queue in level 16, is feminine.

tts_strings: बारिश में नेटवर्क चला जाता है।

learn.title_en: पासवर्ड डालना — you put a password in, not write it
learn.explanation_en: पासवर्ड is masculine, and flag it. The thing to learn with it is the verb: you डालना a password — literally put it in — not लिखना it. That collocation extends across the whole area: नंबर डालना, ओटीपी डालना, पिन डालना. Getting the noun and picking the wrong verb is the commonest way to sound translated rather than fluent, and it is why the Module 8 brief made collocation its own game.

examples.note: डालना, not लिखना.
भूल जाना takes no ने, for two separate reasons — Module 11.
मत for an instruction, and बताना for information.

common_error.why_en: लिखना would mean writing it down somewhere. Entering it into a field is डालना.

practice.explanation_en: पासवर्ड डालना — and the same verb for नंबर, ओटीपी and पिन.

game.question_en: Which word means a one-time code sent to your phone?
game.explanation_en: ओटीपी, which is used constantly in India and always with डालना.

summary.recap_en: All three of these are masculine, which is the default for a consonant-final English noun in Hindi. ऐप takes a Hindi oblique plural once it is absorbed — ऐपों में. नेटवर्क is the signal, and it does the failing rather than you. And a password is डाला, not लिखा.
summary.next_up_en: Next: the loanwords that break the default.

learn.title_en: The feminine loanwords are a list, not a mystery
learn.explanation_en: Level 37 said a loanword's gender is simply assigned. That is true but not very useful, and here is the more helpful version: the default for an English noun in Hindi is masculine, and the feminines are a learnable set. Flag स्क्रीन. It is one of them — स्क्रीन टूट गई, not टूट गया. So are फ़ाइल, बस, ट्रेन, कार, लाइन, पार्टी, कंपनी, and every word ending in -ing: मीटिंग, बुकिंग, सिटिंग. Learn the exceptions and the default handles the rest.

examples.note: गई, feminine.

examples.hindi: बड़ी स्क्रीन पर देखना अच्छा लगता है।
examples.read_as: baṛii skriin par dekhnaa acchaa lagtaa hai.
examples.english: It's nice to watch on a big screen.
examples.note: बड़ी feminine, but लगता masculine because देखना is the subject.
Another feminine loanword — the same sentence appeared in a Module 12 office dialogue.

common_error.why_en: स्क्रीन is one of the feminine loanwords, against the masculine default.

practice.prompt_en: Which of these English loanwords is masculine in Hindi?
practice.explanation_en: स्कूल is masculine, following the default. The other three are among the feminine exceptions.

game.question_en: Which loanword ending would reliably tell you a word is feminine?
game.explanation_en: Words in -ing are consistently feminine: मीटिंग, बुकिंग, सिटिंग, पार्किंग. The other endings give you nothing.

learn.title_en: An -आ word that is masculine after all
learn.explanation_en: Flag डेटा — a loanword's gender is never visible in its shape. It ends in -आ and it is masculine, which is the ordinary Hindi pattern — and it is worth putting beside level 35, where a whole class of Sanskrit -आ nouns turned out to be feminine: घोषणा, समस्या, व्यवस्था, चर्चा. Those are the exception. An English loanword ending in -आ follows the default instead. In everyday use डेटा usually means mobile data: डेटा ख़त्म हो गया, the data has run out.

examples.note: गया, masculine — and ख़त्म from the corner shop in level 3.

examples.english: All the data is on the phone.
examples.note: सारा, masculine.
Two English words compounded and treated as one masculine noun.

common_error.why_en: डेटा is masculine. The -आ feminines of level 35 are Sanskrit words, not loanwords.

practice.prompt_en: Why is डेटा masculine when घोषणा is feminine?
options: There is no reason at all
The -आ feminines are a Sanskrit class; loanwords follow the masculine default
practice.explanation_en: Two different systems meeting in one ending.

game.question_en: Which word means information in the general sense?
game.explanation_en: जानकारी is information, feminine and built with the -ई suffix. आँकड़े are figures and सूचना is a notice or a piece of information.

learn.title_en: करना and होना — one borrowed word, two verbs
learn.explanation_en: डाउनलोड is masculine, and flag it. Like every borrowed verb it needs a Hindi verb to carry the grammar, and it takes two: डाउनलोड करना when you do it, and डाउनलोड होना when it happens. फ़ाइल डाउनलोड हो रही है, the file is downloading; मैंने फ़ाइल डाउनलोड की, I downloaded the file. That पair covers most borrowed verbs — अपडेट करना और होना, कैंसिल करना और होना, चार्ज करना और होना.

examples.note: रही, feminine, agreeing with फ़ाइल — not with डाउनलोड.
किया, masculine, agreeing with ऐप.
Here डाउनलोड is the noun itself, and पूरा agrees with it.

common_error.why_en: The file is not doing the downloading. When the thing undergoes the action, it takes होना.

practice.prompt_en: फ़ाइल डाउनलोड हो रही है means what?
practice.explanation_en: होना for what happens to the thing; करना for what somebody does.

game.question_en: Which borrowed verb means to upload?
game.explanation_en: अपलोड करना. All four take करना for the doing and होना for the happening.

summary.recap_en: The masculine default holds for डेटा and डाउनलोड; स्क्रीन is one of the feminine exceptions, along with फ़ाइल, बस, ट्रेन, कार and every -ing word. And a borrowed verb takes करना when you do it and होना when it happens to the thing.
summary.next_up_en: Next: three borrowings whose gender has not finished settling.

learn.title_en: The easiest kind of loanword — no gender at all
learn.explanation_en: ऑनलाइन is an adverb and an adjective and it never inflects, so it has no gender to get wrong. That makes it the easiest kind of borrowing there is: ऑनलाइन ख़रीदना, ऑनलाइन क्लास, फ़ॉर्म ऑनलाइन भरिए. Its opposite ऑफ़लाइन behaves the same way. You have already met ऑनलाइन twice without being taught it — on the ticket-window sign in level 16 and in the membership reminder in level 30 — which is what a graded reader is for.

examples.note: ऑनलाइन changes for nothing.

examples.hindi: आजकल सब कुछ ऑनलाइन मिल जाता है।
examples.read_as: aajkal sab kuchh ônlaain mil jaataa hai.
examples.english: These days you get everything online.
examples.note: आजकल from level 4.

examples.english: Is the class online or in person?
examples.note: ऑफ़लाइन in India usually means in person rather than disconnected.

common_error.why_en: There is no adjective form to build. The word is already doing that job.

practice.prompt_en: In Indian usage, ऑफ़लाइन क्लास means what?
practice.explanation_en: ऑफ़लाइन has come to mean in person, which is not quite its English sense.

game.question_en: Which Hindi phrase means in person?
game.explanation_en: आमने-सामने, face to face — an echo compound like पूछताछ and धक्का-मुक्की.

learn.title_en: A two-word English phrase, treated as one Hindi noun
learn.explanation_en: सोशल मीडिया is borrowed whole and behaves as a single masculine noun — flag it. The postposition to learn with it is पर: सोशल मीडिया पर, on social media, in the same way as फ़ोन पर and टीवी पर. Hindi does this readily with English phrases: क्रेडिट कार्ड, ट्रैफ़िक जाम, फ़ूड कोर्ट, बजट सत्र. The phrase arrives intact and then takes Hindi endings and postpositions as a unit.

examples.hindi: ये ख़बर सोशल मीडिया पर फैल गई।
examples.read_as: ye ḳhabar soshal miiḍiyaa par phail gaii.
examples.english: The news spread on social media.
examples.note: गई agrees with feminine ख़बर, from level 29, not with सोशल मीडिया.

examples.hindi: वो सोशल मीडिया से दूर रहते हैं।
examples.read_as: vo soshal miiḍiyaa se duur rahte haiṁ.
examples.note: से दूर रहना, to keep away from.

examples.hindi: सोशल मीडिया का असर बहुत है।
examples.read_as: soshal miiḍiyaa kaa asar bahut hai.
examples.english: Social media has a lot of influence.
examples.note: का, masculine. असर — effect or influence, also masculine.

common_error.why_en: पर, like फ़ोन पर and टीवी पर. में would put you inside it.

practice.prompt_en: Which postposition goes with सोशल मीडिया?
practice.explanation_en: पर — the same as फ़ोन पर, टीवी पर, इंटरनेट पर.

game.question_en: Which word means influence or effect?
game.explanation_en: असर is influence, Urdu-side. प्रभाव is its Sanskrit-side partner, and माध्यम is a medium.

tts_strings: ये ख़बर सोशल मीडिया पर फैल गई।
सोशल मीडिया का असर बहुत है।

learn.title_en: Some borrowings have not finished settling
learn.explanation_en: Here is the honest end of the loanword story. Flag वीडियो कॉल. It is usually treated as masculine, and that is what to say — but कॉल on its own is very often feminine: कॉल आई, the call came. Speakers differ, the same speaker differs on different days, and neither version will be misunderstood. Gender assignment in Hindi is a live process rather than a finished one, and recent borrowings are still in the middle of it. मैसेज and ईमेल are in the same unsettled state.

examples.hindi: शाम को वीडियो कॉल करते हैं।
examples.read_as: shaam ko viiḍiyo kôl karte haiṁ.
examples.english: Let's video call in the evening.
examples.note: Present tense making a plan, from Module 12.

examples.english: There was a call just now.
examples.note: आई, feminine — which is what most speakers say for कॉल alone.

examples.hindi: वीडियो कॉल पर बात हो गई।
examples.read_as: viiḍiyo kôl par baat ho gaii.
examples.english: We spoke on a video call.
examples.note: पर again, and बात होना from Module 12.

common_error.wrong: treating every uncertain loanword as an error
common_error.right: accepting that कॉल, मैसेज and ईमेल vary
common_error.why_en: These are genuinely unsettled. Choose one, be consistent, and expect to hear the other.

practice.prompt_en: What does this level say about words like कॉल and ईमेल?
options: Their gender is still unsettled and speakers differ
practice.explanation_en: Assignment is an ongoing process, not a completed one.

game.question_en: Which word is the Hindi for a telephone conversation?
game.explanation_en: बातचीत, an echo compound from बात, and the Hindi name of Module 12. संपर्क is contact and संदेश is a message.

tts_strings: शाम को वीडियो कॉल करते हैं।

summary.recap_en: ऑनलाइन has no gender to get wrong. सोशल मीडिया is a whole English phrase behaving as one masculine noun, and it takes पर. And कॉल, मैसेज and ईमेल are still unsettled — gender assignment in Hindi is a process that is currently happening, not one that finished.
summary.next_up_en: Next: verbs, and the pattern that turns an intransitive one into a transitive one.

items.gloss_en: to be settled, to get done

learn.title_en: निपटना and निपटाना — the -आ that makes a verb transitive
learn.explanation_en: निपटना is intransitive: काम निपट गया, the work got done, with nobody named. Add -आ and you get निपटाना, the transitive: मैंने काम निपटाया, I got the work done. That -आ is the same machinery as the causatives in Module 11, working here to make a plain transitive pair. Hindi has dozens: बनना and बनाना, कटना and काटना, उलझना and उलझाना, सुलझना and सुलझाना. You met निपटाना already, in the power-cut message in level 32.

examples.note: Intransitive, so no ने and no agent.

examples.english: I got all the work done.
examples.note: Transitive, so ने, and किया-type agreement with काम.

examples.english: He isn't easy to deal with.
examples.note: से निपटना, to deal with somebody — a different sense, and a useful one.

common_error.why_en: निपटना cannot take ने because it is intransitive. If you are the one doing it, you need निपटाना.

practice.prompt_en: What does adding -आ to a verb like निपटना do?
practice.explanation_en: निपटना becomes निपटाना, बनना becomes बनाना, उलझना becomes उलझाना.

game.question_en: Which verb means to finish something you were doing?
game.explanation_en: ख़त्म करना is simply to finish. निपटाना carries the sense of clearing something off your list, and निपटना is what happens to the task.

learn.title_en: टालना — and टालमटोल, the art of putting things off
learn.explanation_en: टालना is to put something off, and it carries a faint disapproval that स्थगित करना does not: a committee स्थगित करता है an event, but a person टालता है a difficult conversation. You met स्थगित in the postponed-gathering message in level 23. The noun टालमटोल is an echo compound like पूछताछ and धक्का-मुक्की, and it means procrastination or stalling — often with the implication that somebody is doing it deliberately.

examples.english: Don't put it off till tomorrow.
examples.note: कल पर टालना, to push to tomorrow. मत for an instruction.

examples.hindi: वो हर बार बात टाल देता है।
examples.read_as: vo har baar baat ṭaal detaa hai.
examples.english: He dodges the subject every time.
examples.note: बात टालना, to deflect a topic — the देना vector making it decisive.
The echo compound as a noun.

common_error.wrong: मीटिंग टाल दी गई है — said of a formal announcement
common_error.right: मीटिंग स्थगित कर दी गई है
common_error.why_en: Both are correct Hindi, but टालना hints that somebody chose to avoid it. An official notice uses स्थगित.

practice.explanation_en: And it usually implies the stalling is deliberate.

game.question_en: Which word would an official notice use for a postponement?
game.explanation_en: स्थगित, from level 23. देरी is a delay that happened rather than one that was decided.

items.gloss_en: to handle, to manage, to steady

learn.title_en: संभालना covers more ground than any English single word
learn.explanation_en: संभालना runs from the physical to the emotional without changing shape. You संभालो a glass that is about to fall, a business, a department after somebody leaves, and a person who is upset. English needs catch, manage, take over and comfort; Hindi uses one verb and lets the object decide. It also appears as सँभालना with a chandrabindu, and both spellings are standard. You met it in the leave application in level 31, where Mr Sharma was going to संभाल the work.

examples.note: Physical, and urgent.

examples.english: The son runs the business now.
examples.note: कारोबार — business, Urdu-side and masculine.
ख़ुद को, oneself — and the emotional end of the range.

common_error.wrong: मैं तुम्हें संभालूँगा — meant as "I'll look after you"
common_error.why_en: संभालना a person means steadying them in a crisis. For ongoing care, ख़याल रखना is the phrase, from level 4.

practice.explanation_en: Steadying yourself in a difficult moment, not general self-care.

game.question_en: Which verb means to take responsibility for running something?
game.explanation_en: चलाना is to run or operate — a business, a car, a household. संभालना is closer to taking charge of it, often from somebody else.

summary.recap_en: Adding -आ turns an intransitive verb transitive: निपटना becomes निपटाना, and Hindi has dozens of such pairs. टालना carries a hint of deliberate avoidance where स्थगित करना does not. And संभालना covers catching, managing, taking over and steadying, with the object deciding which.
summary.next_up_en: Next: tangling and untangling, and a verb only for feelings.

learn.title_en: सुलझाना — untangling a thread and settling a dispute
learn.explanation_en: सुलझाना is the transitive of सुलझना, following the -आ pattern from the last level. It means to untangle physically and to resolve figuratively, and Hindi uses the same word for both without any sense of metaphor: उलझे धागे सुलझाना, to untangle knotted thread, and मामला सुलझाना, to settle a matter. News writing prefers it to the heavier हल करना for disputes between people, because it suggests the tangle came about by accident rather than by fault.

examples.note: सुलझना, the intransitive, with no agent named.
सुलझाना, the transitive, so ने.

examples.english: This problem is hard to work out.
examples.note: An infinitive as the subject.

common_error.why_en: सुलझना is intransitive and cannot take ने. With an agent you need सुलझाना.

practice.explanation_en: सुलझना — the matter resolves itself. सुलझाना needs somebody to do it.

game.question_en: Which phrase would a maths textbook use for solving a problem?
game.explanation_en: हल करना, from हल, a solution. सुलझाना is for tangles and disputes rather than for sums.

items.gloss_en: to get tangled, to get entangled

learn.title_en: उलझना and सुलझना, and the सु- that means good
learn.explanation_en: उलझना is to get tangled and सुलझना is to come untangled — a matched pair, and the सु- in the second one is the Sanskrit prefix meaning good or well. You have been meeting it without being told: सुविधा a good arrangement, सुरक्षा safety, सुंदर beautiful, सुशासन good governance. Its opposite is दुर्-, which gave you दुर्भाग्य in level 33 and also gives दुर्घटना an accident and दुर्व्यवहार mistreatment. The noun from उलझना is उलझन, feminine — confusion, or a knot in the mind.

examples.note: Plural masculine, so गए.

examples.english: I don't want to get caught up in this.
examples.note: में उलझना, to get entangled in something.

examples.hindi: उसकी उलझन समझ में आती है।
examples.read_as: uskii uljhan samajh meṁ aatii hai.
examples.note: उलझन, feminine, and समझ में आना from level 9.

common_error.why_en: उलझना is intransitive, so no ने. The transitive is उलझाना, to tangle something.

practice.prompt_en: What does the prefix सु- mean?
practice.explanation_en: सुविधा, सुरक्षा, सुंदर, सुलझना — and its opposite दुर्- gives दुर्भाग्य and दुर्घटना.

game.explanation_en: दुर्घटना — दुर् plus घटना, an event. And it is another -आ feminine, from level 35.

tts_strings: उसकी उलझन समझ में आती है।

items.gloss_en: to convey, to make a feeling known

learn.title_en: बताना, दिखाना, जताना — three ways of making something known
learn.explanation_en: बताना is for information: पता बताना, tell an address. दिखाना is for things that can be seen: रास्ता दिखाना, show the way. जताना is only for feelings and attitudes — नाराज़गी जताना to express annoyance, संदेह जताना to voice doubt, दुख जताना to express regret, आपत्ति जताना to raise an objection. News writing uses it constantly, because it lets a report say that somebody made a feeling public without quoting them. You met it twice in the news block, at levels 38 and 40.

examples.note: जताई, feminine, agreeing with नाराज़गी.
जताया, masculine, agreeing with संदेह.

examples.hindi: उसने कभी अपनी नाराज़गी नहीं जताई।
examples.read_as: usne kabhii apnii naaraazgii nahiiṁ jataaii.
examples.english: He never let his annoyance show.
examples.note: The negative, and कभी नहीं for never.

common_error.why_en: जताना is only for feelings. A road is shown, not conveyed as a sentiment.

practice.prompt_en: Which of these can जताना take as its object?
practice.explanation_en: Only feelings and attitudes. Facts take बताना and visible things take दिखाना.

game.explanation_en: Both work: रास्ता दिखाना is leading somebody along it, रास्ता बताना is giving directions. Only जताना is impossible.

summary.recap_en: सु- means good and दुर्- means bad — सुविधा and दुर्घटना, सुलझना and उलझना. उलझन is the noun for a tangle in the mind. And जताना is reserved for feelings, where बताना takes facts and दिखाना takes things you can see.
summary.next_up_en: Next: the sixth reading block — the last news items, and the first narratives.
